# YepIts.ai

> YepIts.ai is an AI-powered YouTube tool that turns long videos into concise, accurate summaries AND publish-ready blog posts. Paste any YouTube URL to get key points, takeaways, and clickable timestamps — or convert a video into a complete blog post with title, meta description, intro, sections, FAQ, and conclusion. Free tier: 3 summaries and 1 blog post per day (videos up to 15-30 min). Pro tier: $7/month for unlimited usage with no video length cap.

## Product Pages

- [YepIts.ai Homepage](https://yepits.ai/) — Paste any YouTube URL and get an AI summary or blog post in seconds
- [Pricing](https://yepits.ai/#pricing) — Free (3 summaries/day, 1 blog post/day, videos ≤15-30 min) and Pro ($7/mo, unlimited)
- [Sign Up](https://yepits.ai/) — Use the homepage; no account required for the free tier

## Tools

- [YouTube to Blog Post Converter](https://yepits.ai/blog-tool) — Turn any YouTube video into a publish-ready blog post in 30 seconds. Includes title, meta description, intro, sections, FAQ, and conclusion.
- [YouTube to Article](https://yepits.ai/youtube-to-article) — Convert YouTube videos into clean, publishable articles. Free, no sign-up required.
- [Video to SEO Article](https://yepits.ai/video-to-seo-article) — Convert any video into an SEO-optimized article built to rank in search.
